description: Projective duality bounds the ramification degree of a proper rational plane quartic by three; combined with the Keller exclusions, the only remaining rational-quartic leading strata are (deg gamma, tangent-syzygy type)=(2,(2,2)) and (3,(1,2)).

members.statement: A proper basepoint-free rational-quartic leading image of a quartic Keller map cannot be immersed or simply ramified; equivalently, its ramification factor gamma has degree at least two.
